sentences.text:
Vijay Pal Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23
March, 2023
Author: Krishan Pahal

Bench: Krishan Pahal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 79
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1615 of 2023
Applicant :- Vijay Pal Singh And 2 Others

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Gaurav Singh Chauhan

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Krishan Pahal,J.

Heard Sri Gaurav Singh Chauhan, learned counsel for applicants as well as Sri V.K.S. Parmar,
learned Additional Government Advocate for State.
The present application for anticipatory bail has been filed for protection in regard to Case Crime No.132 of 2011, under Sections 420, 406, 504, 506 I.P.C., P.S. Babugarh, District Hapur.
This is the second anticipatory bail application on behalf of the applicants.
The first anticipatory bail application was withdrawn with to seek appropriate remedy at appropriate forum.

After arguing for some time, applicants' counsel submits that the present application for anticipatory bail may be dismissed as withdrawn with liberty to file a regular bail application which may be decided keeping in view the guidelines as laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another reported in 2022 SCC OnLine SC 825
entities.label: PRECEDENT

Vijay Pal Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/194039373/
1 Learned A.G.A. has no objection to the prayer of learned counsel for the applicants.

entities.text: Vijay Pal Singh And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In view of the above, considering the aforesaid alternative prayer made by learned counsel for the applicants, it is directed that the applicants shall surrender before the concerned court below within one month from today and in case a regular bail application is filed, the same be decided in view of the law laid down by the Supreme Court in case of Satender Kumar Antil (supra).
For the period of one month from today or till the time of surrender of the applicants before the concerned court below, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants,
in the above case.
With the above observations and directions, this application is disposed of.
Order Date :- 23.3.2023
